title: Samsung Announces Hardware Partnership with Activision for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Launch
content_md: Samsung announced a hardware partnership with Activision Blizzard for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. According to Dot Esports, the deal includes display optimization, live showcase streaming, and Gamescom 2026 participation. Article Link: Samsung Activision Odyssey G9 Display Integration Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4 Launch Collaboration
exclude_reason: Samsung Odyssey G9 display + Call of Duty product partnership announcement. Not a security story.
